description: Jo’s attempt to protect Piper becomes an investigation into the girl’s origin and extraordinary abilities, drawing her family, reporter Benny Gallagher and increasingly dangerous corporate forces into a struggle over who Piper is allowed to become.

s01e01.description: Police chief Jo Evans finds an amnesiac girl near a mysterious plane crash and brings her home, while reporter Benny Gallagher joins the search for answers about who Piper is.

s01e02.description: Jo and Chris investigate the people pursuing Piper as Abby tries to unlock the girl’s memory and Jo makes a risky bargain with Benny to keep her safe.

s01e03.description: Piper falls dangerously ill while Jo and Benny investigate tech magnate Richard Kindred, and Alex works to decode a radio signal connected to the crash.

s01e04.description: New information about Piper’s origins forces Jo to reconsider sheltering her, while Benny targets Kindred’s secret files and Chris protects a difficult informant.

s01e05.description: Jo tries to prove Kindred ordered the attack on Benny and April while Piper is troubled by intense visions that hint at abilities she does not understand.

s01e06.description: Jo and Benny investigate the death of Kindred’s former business partner as Mia and Piper experiment with Piper’s powers and Alex confronts Ed about his health.

s01e07.description: Jo and Chris race to find Piper before she is placed in danger, while Jo’s earlier deception creates a painful rupture with Alex and Ed at home.

s01e08.description: The FBI arrives in Southold and complicates Jo’s search for Emily, while Alex and Piper pursue answers on the road and the family gathers for Mia’s birthday.

s01e09.description: Jo and Chris evade the FBI while tracing a cyberterrorist group, Ed is offered a suspiciously promising cancer treatment, and a mysterious woman targets Piper.

s01e10.description: A long-awaited lead may finally reveal Piper’s location, sending Jo and Brooks after her while Alex and Chris uncover a suspicious shipment at the harbor.

s01e11.description: Jo and Brooks assemble an unlikely team to reach Piper, while Piper tries to save Benny from Helen’s plan and Alex receives an offer that could change his life.

s01e12.description: Jo makes a dangerous deal to stop Helen and protect Piper as Helen attempts to reproduce Piper’s abilities and Benny struggles to regain Jo’s trust.

s01e13.description: With Jo and Brooks in danger and Helen’s plan nearing completion, Piper gathers unexpected allies and takes action to rescue them before it is too late.
